scripts.container:run: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -p 8080:8080 -e SERVER_PORT=8080 --name forge-q3-allinone-local forge-q3-allinone:local
scripts.tunnel:quick: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.cloudflare.yml up --build q3-relay cloudflared
scripts.tunnel:named: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.cloudflare-token.yml up --build q3-relay cloudflared-named
scripts.tunnel:local-managed: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.cloudflare-local.yml up --build -d q3-relay cloudflared-local
